title: yenc.rs InlineYEncBlock::begin_length is wrong for error blocks
description:
In yenc.rs decode_one_block(), when yencoding::decode() returns Err, consumed = find_line_end(slice, 0), which is the length of just the =ybegin line. This value is stored as InlineYEncBlock::begin_length.

The documented invariant for begin_length states: 'from the start of =ybegin through the end of =yend (inclusive of its newline)'. For error blocks this invariant is violated — begin_length is only the =ybegin line length, so raw[begin_offset..begin_offset+begin_length] does NOT yield the complete block.

The doc comment on begin_length does not mention that is_encoding_problem=true invalidates the slicing invariant (unlike InlineUUBlock which explicitly warns 'Always check is_encoding_problem before using this field').

Fix: either (a) add the same caveat to InlineYEncBlock::begin_length doc as InlineUUBlock has, or (b) set begin_length=0 on error just as InlineUUBlock does for error items.
